applicant.name: Dr. Pieter de Vries
applicant.organisation: University Medical Center Utrecht, Julius Center

request.purpose: Public health monitoring of chronic disease burden for the regional health authorities.
request.question: How many patients have both hypertension and type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: patients who have both hypertension and type 2 diabetes.
